name: board-qa-prep
description: Board Q&A prep, step 05 of the Landing Loop. Reads a bet's landing/<bet>.json record and drafts the questions a board will likely ask. Each is answered, quoting the record's figure and its source, or open, with an owner and a due date. Code computes every figure and checks every reworded answer. Writes only the board_qa key and one HTML page in the Leader Report style.
